en.topic_title: Australia jails marketing executive who compiled reports for China

zh.topic_title: Australia jails marketing executive who compiled reports for China

en.topic_title: Australia jails marketing executive who compiled reports for China
en.topic_summary:
An Australian man convicted of reckless foreign interference for compiling reports for Chinese intelligence was sentenced to more than three years in jail by a Sydney court on Thursday.



Downing Centre, a seat of the District Court in Sydney. Photo: Wikicommons.



Marketing executive Alexander Csergo, 58, was arrested in Sydney by Australian police in 2023, shortly after he returned from living in Shanghai.



He was accused of accepting cash from Chinese intelligence agents to write reports
